description: React component for a course purchase button with logic for checkout, login, and demo access, specific to the 'sql' course.

classes.name: BuyButton
classes.description: React functional component for rendering a purchase button with different variants and purchase logic.

methods.name: initPurchase
methods.description: Initializes the purchase process, checking login status and creating a checkout session.

methods.name: onBuyClick
methods.description: Handles the buy button click, checking login and enrollment status, then initiating purchase.

methods.name: onReadSampleClick
methods.description: Handles the demo access button click, checking login and redirecting to demo.
